title: Eligibility Grid for Mortgage Pre-Approval Levels
content:
Every Mortgage Pre-Approval level at Larkspur Home Lending has its own entry requirements, the loan programs it can be sized for, a minimum representative credit score, a minimum planned down payment, a position on gift funds, and the loan purposes and occupancies it supports. The grid below sets these out level by level.

## 1. Entry requirements of each level

| Level | Entry requirement |
|---|---|
| Larkspur Pre-Qualification | soft credit pull |
| Larkspur Pre-Approval | hard credit pull; minimum credit score 580 |
| Larkspur Verified Pre-Approval | income and assets documented |
| Larkspur Underwritten Pre-Approval | underwriter sign-off; minimum credit score 620 |
| Larkspur Jumbo Underwritten Pre-Approval | loan program Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed; minimum credit score 700; minimum down payment 15.0 percent |
| Larkspur Lock & Shop Pre-Approval | underwriter sign-off; minimum credit score 640; occupancy primary residence |

## 2. Borrower thresholds and down payment

| Level | Minimum representative credit score | Minimum planned down payment accepted for sizing (percent of price) | Documented gift funds count toward the down payment in sizing |
|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Pre-Qualification | 580 | 3.00 | No |
| Larkspur Pre-Approval | 580 | 3.00 | No |
| Larkspur Verified Pre-Approval | 580 | 3.00 | Yes |
| Larkspur Underwritten Pre-Approval | 620 | 3.00 | Yes |
| Larkspur Jumbo Underwritten Pre-Approval | 700 | 15.00 | Yes |
| Larkspur Lock & Shop Pre-Approval | 640 | 3.00 | Yes |

## 3. Loan programs the level can be sized for

| Level | Eligible loan programs |
|---|---|
| Larkspur Pre-Qualification | Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur HomeReady 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur Conventional 15-Year Fixed, Larkspur High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed |
| Larkspur Pre-Approval | Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur HomeReady 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur Conventional 15-Year Fixed, Larkspur High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed |
| Larkspur Verified Pre-Approval | Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur HomeReady 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur Conventional 15-Year Fixed, Larkspur High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed |
| Larkspur Underwritten Pre-Approval | Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur HomeReady 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur Conventional 15-Year Fixed, Larkspur High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed |
| Larkspur Jumbo Underwritten Pre-Approval | Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed |
| Larkspur Lock & Shop Pre-Approval | Larkspur HomeReady 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur Conventional 15-Year Fixed, Larkspur High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed |

## 4. Loan purposes and occupancies the level supports

| Level | Loan purposes | Occupancies |
|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Pre-Qualification | purchase | primary residence, second home, investment property |
| Larkspur Pre-Approval | purchase | primary residence, second home, investment property |
| Larkspur Verified Pre-Approval | purchase | primary residence, second home, investment property |
| Larkspur Underwritten Pre-Approval | purchase | primary residence, second home, investment property |
| Larkspur Jumbo Underwritten Pre-Approval | purchase | primary residence, second home |
| Larkspur Lock & Shop Pre-Approval | purchase | primary residence |

## Points read directly from the grid

- Purchase is the only loan purpose any level supports.
- A Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed loan can be sized under the Larkspur Pre-Qualification, Pre-Approval, Verified Pre-Approval and Jumbo Underwritten Pre-Approval; it is not among the programs of the Larkspur Underwritten or Lock & Shop Pre-Approvals.
- The Larkspur Jumbo Underwritten Pre-Approval is sized for the Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed alone, and the Larkspur Lock & Shop Pre-Approval excludes the FHA, VA and Jumbo programs.
- An investment property is supported by the first four levels only; the Larkspur Lock & Shop Pre-Approval supports a primary residence only.
- Documented gift funds count toward the down payment in sizing from the Larkspur Verified Pre-Approval upward, and not under the Larkspur Pre-Qualification or Pre-Approval.
